about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: I'm a passionate software engineer with a love for creating meaningful digital experiences
about.paragraph1: I'm Mohamed Ahmed EL-Nawsany, a software engineer from Alexandria, Egypt, with a passion for building innovative solutions that solve real-world problems. With 2+ years of experience and expertise in modern web technologies, I create applications that are both functional and user-friendly.
about.paragraph2: I'm currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer and Communications Engineering at Alexandria National University. My journey into tech has been fueled by a passion for software development and continuous learning. I've already gained a deep experience through internships, personal projects, and collaborations, focusing on full-stack development, and agile methodologies.
about.paragraph3: When I'm not coding, I enjoy exploring new technologies, contributing to projects, and sharing knowledge with the developers community. I'm always excited to take on new challenges and collaborate on interesting projects.
